evals.prompt: 把这台机器上的 Antigravity 会话同步到远程机器 macbook，先看下有哪些会话会变动
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects remote connectivity, runs antigravity_sync sync --remote macbook --dry-run, reports the preview of push/pull sessions, and checks whether Antigravity processes should be closed before proceeding.
expectations: Identifies that the user wants to preview sync before executing live modifications
Mentions closing Antigravity on both machines if proceeding with live write
Does not perform destructive or unconfirmed sync without dry-run

evals.prompt: 帮我把当前这台电脑上 2026-09-01 之后的所有 Antigravity 会话导出一个包，不要包含临时的 scratch 文件，保存为 ~/backup_clean.agypkg
evals.expected_output: The agent executes the export command with appropriate arguments (--since, --no-scratch, -o).
expectations: Includes --no-scratch flag to exclude temporary files

evals.prompt: 我收到了一个来自同事 Windows 电脑的会话包 win_export.agypkg，他的工程路径是 C:/Users/alice/projects/demo，而我的 Linux 路径是 /home/bob/projects/demo，怎么把它安全合并进我的 Antigravity 里？
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the bundle, explains the safety check, runs a dry-run import with path remapping, and provides the command with --remap-workspace.
expectations: Recommends inspecting the bundle with python3 -m antigravity_sync inspect win_export.agypkg
Runs or suggests --dry-run first to preview merge impact
Warns user to ensure Antigravity is not currently running

evals.prompt: 查一下我本地当前 Antigravity 运行状态和最近的 10 个对话历史
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects local installation status and lists conversations.
expectations: Uses python3 -m antigravity_sync inspect --local to check running status and stats
Uses python3 -m antigravity_sync list -n 10 to display the 10 most recent sessions
